nodes.title: SG-8.3.1 Rewrite the repo-root context.md to the real stack
nodes.body:
Context: the repo-root context.md still holds the README-only scan (hello Worldseed, Frameworks: UNKNOWN, Entry points, Workflows, Scan meta, Residual unknowns, Traceability index). Desired behavior: it describes the real stack and the game/src, game/frontend/src, game/docs and backend modules. Expected result: both context.md tests in game/frontend/tests/contextDoc.test.ts pass. Why: the docs must match the code.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the repo-root context.md, when missingTerms(text, STACK_TERMS) runs, then it returns [].
- Given the module table, when contextModulePaths(text) runs, then it contains game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/ and every path exists on disk.
- Given context.md, when searched, then it holds none of: hello Worldseed, Traceability index, Frameworks: UNKNOWN, the Executable / server / CLI main UNKNOWN row.


## Scope
- In scope: Stack section and module table of the repo-root context.md
- In scope: Contract docs on docsCheck helpers
- Out of scope: SG-8.3.2 GDD tests
- Out of scope: backend/ Go code and the contribution/round API
- Out of scope: Gameplay changes
- Preserve: game/frontend/tests/contextDoc.test.ts tests
- Preserve: phaser-pin guard test


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0 (no Phaser 4 migration); the phaser-pin guard test must keep passing
- No change to what the player sees or can do
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- No test is deleted or skipped
- No source file in game/src or game/frontend/src is over 200 lines
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- backend/ (Go) and the contribution/round API are out of scope; frontend/src/api/client.ts unchanged
- Tests mock only what is external


## Definition of done
- Both context.md unit tests pass
- Typecheck passes in game/frontend


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · context.md names the real stack with the Go backend out of scope
nodes.body:
Context: STACK_TERMS in game/frontend/src/lib/docsCheck.ts is ['Phaser 3.90','React','Zustand','Radix','Vitest']; the stack text must satisfy it (case-insensitive), so Radix must appear besides the stack named in the intent. Desired behavior: the Stack section lists those terms plus TypeScript, and lists the Go backend as out of scope. Expected result: the stack terms unit test passes.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given context.md, when missingTerms(text, STACK_TERMS) runs, then the result is [].
- Given context.md, when read, then it does not contain Frameworks: UNKNOWN and says backend (Go) is out of scope.


## Scope
- In scope: STACK_TERMS contract documentation
- Out of scope: Changing the term list
- Out of scope: GDD
- Preserve: missingTerms behavior


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0 (no Phaser 4 migration)
- backend/ (Go) is out of scope
- No test is deleted or skipped


## Dependencies
- INT-1


## Definition of done
- Stack terms test passes


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · context.md has a real module table and no README-only text
nodes.body:
Context: contextModulePaths extracts backticked game/ and backend/ paths from table rows; missingPaths reports non-existing ones. Desired behavior: the table has the four required rows, every path exists, and the Purpose, Entry points, Workflows, Scan meta, Residual unknowns and Traceability index sections and the hello Worldseed text are removed. Expected result: the module paths and stale text unit test passes.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given context.md, when contextModulePaths runs, then it contains game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/.
- Given those paths, when missingPaths checks existsSync from the repo root, then the result is [].
- Given context.md, when searched, then hello Worldseed, Traceability index and the Executable / server / CLI main UNKNOWN row are absent.


## Scope
- In scope: missingPaths contract documentation
- Out of scope: GDD feature index
- Preserve: indexedPaths and missingPaths behavior


## Technical constraints
- No source file over 200 lines
- backend/ (Go) is out of scope
- No test is deleted or skipped


## Dependencies
- INT-1


## Definition of done
- Module paths and stale text test passes


## Clarifying questions
- None
